FLORECE, JR. Officer-ln-Charge DIR. MARLO L. IRINGAN OIC, OUSLG DIR. ANNA LIZA F. BONAGUA, CESO Ill Bureau of Local Government Development DRAFT LEGAL OPINION RELATIVE TO UTILIZATION OF THE DEVELOPMENT FUND FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF BOBON PUBLIC CEMETERY, BOBON, PROVINCE OF NORTHERN SAMAR 02 February 2021 ACTION REQUESTED For the OIC, DILG's clearance. For the OIC, OUSLG's signature, if amenable, on the attached draft legal opinion on the issue as above-mentioned. REFERENCE Memorandum dated 12 January 2021 from Director Anna Liza F. Bonagua, CESO Ill, Bureau of Local Government Development, requesting this level's opinion regarding the request of the Department of Budget and Management on the utilization of the 20% Development Fund for the establishment of Bobon Public Cemetery.

BACKGROUND In a letter dated 15 October 2020, Municipal Mayor Clara C. Gremio, Municipality of Bobon, requested the opinion/clarification of Secretary Wendel E. Avisado, Department of Budget and Management (DBM), regarding the establishment of Bobon Public Cemetery using the 20% Development Fund. In its response, DBM opined that the Local Government Unit (LGU) of Bobon is in a better position to determine the expenses which are necessary, appropriate, or incidental to the efficient and effective delivery of their services pursuant to Section 16 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", in relation to DBM-DOF-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2, dated 04 December 2020. Despite the foregoing, DBM requests the opinion of this Department regarding the matter to ensure uniform interpretation and application of the aforesaid JMC. THIS LEVEL'S COMMENTS AND/OR RECOMMENDATION Pertinent to herein discussion is Item 3.2.2 of DBM-DOF-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 1, Series of 2020 (JMC 2020-1), dated 04 November 2020, in relation to Section 17(b)(2)(x) of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991" (LGC), which states: "3.2.2 The development projects that may be included under the 20% DF shall be those that are necessary, appropriate, or incidental to efficient and effective local governance, and those which are essential to the promotion of the general welfare of the people." "SECTION 17. Basic Services and Facilities. — (b) Such basic services and facilities include, but are not limited to, the following: (2) For a Municipality: (x) Public cemetery;" Clearly, one of the basic services that a local government unit can provide is the construction and establishment of a public cemetery. Moreover, Item 3.2.5 in the aforesaid JMC clearly enumerated the expenditures which are not allowed to be charged against the 20% Development Fund (DF), and construction of a public cemetery is not one of the excluded expenditures.

Since the DILG-DBM JMC 2017-1 was superseded by the issuance of DBM-DOF-DILG JMC 2020-1, LGUs are now given the prerogative to determine and/or identify the projects that are necessary, appropriate, or incidental to efficient and effective local governance, and those which are essential to the promotion of the general welfare of the people. Provided however, that the identified projects must be in accordance with the general guidelines embodied in DBM-DOF-DILG JMC 2020-1, and must not be included in the enumerated expenditures which cannot be charged against the 20% DF as provided for in Item 3.2.5 thereof. With the express exclusion of the allowable items that can be charged against the 20% DF as provided in Item 3.0 of DILG-DBM JMC 2017-1, we hereby concur with the position of the DBM that the LGU of Bobon is in a better position to determine if the public cemetery is essential and necessary to the promotion of the general welfare of its inhabitants. ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Director IV Legal/91 Approved: Disaoproved: UNDERSECRETAR E NARDO C. FLORECE, JR. Office -In-Charge. DILG FEB 19 2021
